source.title: The AI ​​Assistant returns the same error every time it tries to read a workflow

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body: ## Describe the problem/error/question Whenever I try to use the AI ​​Assistant to help me with a workflow, this error occurs the moment it tries to read the workflow. Furthermore, any subsequent question I ask results in the same error. When I start a new chat while the model isn't trying to read the workflow, it is able to respond. I have already tried using the following models for the AI ​​Assistant, which I configured via the "docker-compose.yml" file: - N8N_INSTANCE_AI_MODEL=openai/qwen3.5:4b - N8N_INSTANCE_AI_MODEL=openai/gemma4:31b-cloud ## What is the error message (if any)? input[2]: unknown input item type: "item_reference" (ref: 77a2ecab-4db0-4180-9c76-b6063544376d) { "error": { "message": "input[2]: unknown input item type: \"item_reference\" (ref: 77a2ecab-4db0-4180-9c76-b6063544376d)", "type": "invalid_request_error", "param": null, "code": null } } ## Please share your workflow/screenshots/recording ### Reading workflow ### Error message ### Models configured ### The same model configured for AI Assistant works fine for Personal Agents ## Additional and complementary information I removed some other information from the [docker-compose.yml](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33926917/docker-compose.yml) file, but kept everything related to n8n. ## Debug info ### core - n8nVersion: 2.44.6 - platform: docker (self-hosted) - nodeJsVersion: 26.12.1 - nodeEnv: production - database: postgres - executionMode: regular - concurrency: -1 - license: enterprise (production) ### storage - success: all - error: all - progress: false - manual: true - binaryMode: filesystem ### pruning - enabled: true - maxAge: 336 hours - maxCount: 10000 executions ### client - userAgent: mozilla/5.0 (windows nt 10.0; win64; x64; rv:158.0) gecko/20100101 firefox/158.0 - isTouchDevice: false Generated at: 2026-10-25T03:52:47.755Z
